verses.gurmukhi: ਧੋਤੇ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਉਜਲੇ ਪਾਟ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਖਰੇ ਅਮੋਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: dhote hovan ujale paaT paTa(n)bar khare amole|

en.bdb: The invaluable clothes made of silk come out bright when washed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੰਗ ਬਿਰੰਗੀ ਰੰਗੀਅਨਿ ਸਭੇ ਰੰਗ ਸੁਰੰਗੁ ਅਡੋਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: ra(n)g bira(n)gee ra(n)geean sabhe ra(n)g sura(n)g addole|

en.bdb: Dye them in any colour they are beautiful in varied colours.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਲੈ ਲੈ ਪੈਨ੍ਹਦੇ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਵੰਸ ਨਿਕੋਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: saahib lai lai painhadhe roop ra(n)g ras va(n)s nikole|

en.bdb: The aristocrat admirers of beauty, colour and joy purchase them and wear them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੇ ਚਜ ਅਚਾਰ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਵਿਚੋਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: sobhaava(n)t suhaavane chaj achaar seegaar vichole|

en.bdb: There those clothes full of grandeur, become means of their adornment in marriage ceremonies.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਲਾ ਕੰਬਲੁ ਉਜਲਾ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਧੋਤੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਨਿਰੋਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: kaalaa ka(n)bal ujalaa hoi na dhote ra(n)g nirole|

en.bdb: But a black blanket neither gets bright when washed nor can be dyed in any colour.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਝਾਕੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨੀਰੁ ਵਿਰੋਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh sun jhaakai a(n)dhar neer virole|

en.bdb: Like wise even after going to the holy congregation and listening to the teachings of the Guru, if someone goes on searching the World Ocean i.e. goes on to have desires for the worldly materials.
Such a cheat is like an abandoned and desolate place.
